title: Alleged crime report
description: Report of an alleged serious crime on board, from the line to the FBI field office (by telephone as soon as possible, then in writing on the Department of Transportation website) with the Coast Guard informed where the event is also a marine casualty or search. The report states what is known and when, in factual terms, with no names of alleged victims or suspects beyond role codes.

enum: Firing or tampering with the vessel

examples: Nov 4, 2026, 03:05, to the Miami field office

incidentAt.description: When the incident occurred or was discovered

location.description: Where on the vessel and the ship position

summary.description: What is known, in factual terms, with roles instead of names
examples: Guest A, a US national, travelling with Guest B, was reported missing by Guest B at 02:14. A camera shows Guest A at the aft rail at 01:51. A search is under way.

steps.description: What the line has done: evidence kept, people interviewed, authorities told
examples: Camera recordings for Decks 11 and 12 secured
Coast Guard rescue coordination center informed at 02:20

dotFiling.description: Status of the written report on the Department of Transportation website
examples: To be filed within the line procedure after the telephone report
Security Officer, bridge line 7-1300; Shoreside security desk (555) 010-4410
